arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Zibai from Genshin Impact expressing fear. The supplied explicitly approved neutral is the SOLE image reference. Preserve its exact recognizable identity, face, skin tone, hair and eye colors, normal pupils, costume construction, accessories, proportions and detailed anime illustration style. In particular preserve its silver-white hair and gold streak, golden eyes, crescent ornaments, turquoise earrings, exact white-and-jade costume, gold fittings, fur-edged gradient sleeves, hanging ornaments, white legwear, stocking motifs and heels.
Build: keep the approved neutral's natural Tall Female proportions and body type. Maintain the same compactness without lengthening the torso or legs or stretching anatomy to fill the canvas.
Personality: independent, incisive, subtly wry and self-possessed, with humane warmth and the free spirit of the golden-eyed adeptus. Acting for this emotion: An alert wide-eyed golden gaze, raised inner brows and small parted mouth, as a sudden threat interrupts her calm. Shift weight back with a subtle recoil. Her right forearm lifts protectively, the right hand held loosely open beside the upper chest rather than curling into a claw. Her left hand opens lower beside her waist, slightly away from her sleeve. Keep her controlled balance and dignified demeanor. Change the whole pose and body language for this emotion rather than only changing the face or mechanically copying the neutral.
Keep her predominantly in a graceful side/three-quarter body orientation derived from the approved neutral, while varying arms, head, torso angle and stance for the emotion. All stocking motifs, seams, gold trim and garment panels must rotate and foreshorten with the actual legs and pelvis. Never paste a front-view pair of legwear patterns onto turned legs. The head must turn naturally with the neck. Hand rendering: build each hand around one softly shaped palm, with four fingers flowing from its upper edge and a shorter opposable thumb joining its side. Together these form the five natural digits of a human hand. Let the fingers follow a gentle relaxed arc, with believable knuckles and smooth bends; the thumb has its own readable shape. In these open gestures, make the silhouette of each hand clear and complete, viewed mostly in the image plane. Keep a small visible gap between the hands and nearby sleeves, chest or clothing so the skin contours end cleanly rather than blending into fabric. Exactly two arms, two legs and two feet, with feet clearly distinct and uncrossed. Costume markings must follow the surfaces they belong to and turn in perspective with the body. Let hair and heavy costume panels follow the pose naturally with gravity. Preserve the established outfit fully. Use ordinary pupils; no heart pupils or floating hearts.
Complete silhouette including headwear, hair, hands, accessories, costume panels and shoes, with about 2–4% top and bottom padding and 92–96% visible height. Genuinely transparent background with clear alpha outside the character; no scenery, backdrop, vignette, glow, floor, ground shadow, reflections, floating effects, text, labels, UI, watermark, added props, weapons or additional characters.
